name: context-window-01
title: 上下文窗口

    usage: (percent) => `${percent} full`, headroom: (turns) => `~${turns} turns of headroom`,
    hit: (percent) => `${percent} hit`, summary: (count, tokens, percent) => `${count} items · ${tokens} tokens · ${percent} of window`,
